answer: Validate work across clusters, not inside one grove: every task needs two validators from different funding clusters, each locking 40 POA for two epochs. Validators earn 5 POA on a pass and lose 40 on a fake conviction. Entry charges a delta fee: the first identity from a payout address pays 30 POA, each extra adds 15 POA, so the tenth pays 165. A farm must buy validators in many clusters and pay rising fees, while one honest agent pays once; each conviction sends a ripple through the cluster log, and the chain checks cluster diversity, stakes, and slashes from public records.
